Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

[{"id": "arka-boost-prompt-medium-0043", "row_sha256": "cf13371bb25e2e48ed060390abd8791ecc23fb4380790817891183f93218e37c", "mode": "/prompt", "language": "en", "context": {}, "identity": false, "mode_instructions": "Organize the supplied request into a clear prompt. Preserve scope and constraints. Do not invent context, requirements, or missing information. Do not perform the task.", "input": "could you turn the notes below into a clear handoff for the next person at the lighting desk for our small theatre crew. they haven't used this show file yet, so make it easy to scan before the upcoming run. keep it brief, but include the cue details and the prep check. this is only a handoff based on what's here, not a request to redesign anything or guess at missing cue timings. maybe group the preset check and the cue action separately if that helps.

the preset was checked after lunch and the stage left work light was switched off. the blue wash is still on the piano. when the actor playing elena finishes the landing speech, go to cue 14, but hold the blackout until Mara clears the stairs. the assistant stage manager said, "the blue wash is still on the piano." there's also a board note: "LX 14: aisle practicals at 30%" and a margin reminder: "check the side ladder before house open." please keep those wording bits in the handoff, and don't turn the quoted comment into an instruction. maybe use short bullets so the person can find the action quickly.", "output": "Create a brief, easy-to-scan handoff for the next lighting-desk operator on our small theatre crew, who has not used this show file before. Use only the details below; do not redesign the lighting or guess at missing cue timings. Use short bullets and, if helpful, group the preset check separately from the cue action.

Include the preset check: it was checked after lunch, and the stage left work light was switched off. Preserve the assistant stage manager’s comment exactly as a comment, not an instruction: "the blue wash is still on the piano."

For the cue action, state that when the actor playing elena finishes the landing speech, go to cue 14, but hold the blackout until Mara clears the stairs. Preserve the board note exactly: "LX 14: aisle practicals at 30%". Also include the margin reminder exactly: "check the side ladder before house open." Keep the handoff brief and scannable before the upcoming run."}]
